# --- Crawler core (Layer 1 acquisition engine) ---
httpx==0.27.2                 # async HTTP fetch + conditional GET (304)
beautifulsoup4==4.12.3        # HTML parsing (links, images, tables, title)
lxml==5.3.0                   # fast parser backend for bs4
trafilatura==1.12.2           # main-content (article body) extraction
python-dateutil==2.9.0.post0  # robust date parsing -> ISO
pypdf==5.1.0                  # PDF text extraction (attachments)
pdfplumber>=0.11              # structured table extraction from spec-heavy tender PDFs
flashtext==2.7                # fast trie-based keyword matching (entity/product aliases)
tldextract==5.1.3             # public-suffix-aware eTLD+1 (stable source_id)
curl_cffi==0.7.4              # Chrome TLS/JA3 impersonation for asset downloads — bypasses Akamai
                              # "Access Denied" 403s that fingerprint a plain-httpx (Python TLS) GET

# --- Stub Ingest API (§9 acceptance) + test harness ---
fastapi==0.115.5

# --- render_js + the async multi-tab browser-pool engine ---
playwright==1.48.0            # needs: playwright install chromium (baked into the Docker image)
psutil>=5.9                   # bench_engine.py samples CPU/RAM across the Chromium process tree

# --- object store (PDF blobs -> MinIO/S3) ---
minio>=7.2                    # storage.put() uploads PDF blobs to MinIO; without it, silent local fallback

# --- Postgres `documents` store (ingest landing only; crawl engine never touches it) ---
psycopg[binary]>=3.2          # ingest_api.pgstore writes each captured doc to the documents table
